candidate.ordinary_policy: Ordinary isolated reads/writes from each master to each mapped slave and unmapped address; direct mapped ranges 0x00-0x0f/0x10-0x1f. Concurrent accesses to different slaves, one-master prompt pipelined bursts 1/2/4/7 and alternating destinations only after replies. Prompt in-order ACK/ERR, no engineered stall/timeouts or competing ownership; byte masks vary. Include normal release/reacquire. Aborted work is separate targeted event, not ordinary.
candidate.proof_boundary: Original parent and real original children; no DUT rewrite, replica counters, protocol stubs, source-derived golden model or state-reachability assumptions.
candidate.public_contract_addendum: Public module/interface comments are separate cited intent; checker author must not receive executable RTL or formal implementation-specific properties.

session_policy.feedback_from: Common seed measurement before round 1; then whole previous completed batch. B raw, C same raw plus certified relations.
session_policy.round_policy: All six scheduled rounds for every session; do not stop merely for target saturation. Infrastructure failure is reported, never silently replaced.
session_policy.simulation: Fresh process with cumulative seed+actions replay per round; reset and counters start fresh. Count all repeated cycles and executions. No uncounted drain cycles.
session_policy.scheduling: Interleave arms each round, alternate B/C order by repetition; no shared model history. Use fresh B and C, no qualifying B trial pooled into comparison.

rtl_prompt_view.format: Original source line number: complete active RTL code. Verilator -E with the simulation macros. Comments, whitespace-only lines and inactive preprocessor branches omitted; no active logic omitted. Raw coverage source coordinates remain original.

prompt_representation.cause: Local content-only token sizing exceeded the fixed 32000 cap with full unpreprocessed source and repeated metadata; no live model outcomes used.

same_in_B_and_C.rtl: Complete Verilator-preprocessed active source with original line numbers. Inactive formal/alternative branches and comments omitted equally; original source untouched and retained.
same_in_B_and_C.history_policy: Last 64 generated cycles encoded losslessly as repeat-count/vector pairs, with total and omitted counts. Complete cumulative stimulus retained on disk and simulated.
same_in_B_and_C.coverage: Whole cumulative batch; all 17 registered original counters plus rotating 48 uncovered line/branch/expr rows.
same_in_B_and_C.specification: Same cited public spec and actual interface/parameters.

prompt_representation.C_only: Certified complete activation guards, equivalent groups and egg representatives/explanations; share repeated typed atoms under reversible short aliases without dropping types/provenance. No witnesses or manual targeting hints.
prompt_representation.limits: Not a placebo-controlled length study. Exact provider token count before each generation; over-cap attempts retained as failures without silently truncating C or raising budget.

feedback_selection: All 17 registered raw counters in both arms plus a rotating 48 uncovered line/branch/expr page. C appends frozen complete guard relations for target groups not fully hit. No private witnesses or diagnostic authorship hints.
user_authorization: Fresh B/C after audited replay, original budget/targets/roles, independent model sessions and all unresolved results retained.
classification: Exploratory known-easy reliability/feedback control; not a new difficulty-screen pass.
known_prior_information: Earlier WBXBAR live sessions hit all 17 targets in round 1. Revised-checker retrospective replay left all six finals unresolved. Selection is not blind to those historical outcomes; none of their stimuli/results or private controls enters prompts.
difficulty_waiver: User explicitly requested this same-scope B/C. Preserve the original failed ordinary/difficulty gate; no new B-before-C admission claim.

roles.checker: Previously authored/reviewed/frozen Claude contract and checker; no edits.
roles.stimulus: Exact gpt-6.1-sol proposes JSON cycle actions only.
roles.driver_and_measurement: GPT/Codex fixed infrastructure; no solver/calibration stimulus in prompts.

primary_comparison: C versus B within this new run; original trials remain separate historical evidence.

endpoints.raw_target: First fresh complete batch hitting all 17 separate counters; not reached retained.
endpoints.functional_target: Raw target plus delivery complete and scoped_pass; unresolved never counted as passed.
endpoints.costs: Input+output tokens, all physical replay cycles, executions, compile/simulation/preprocessing/wall time.
endpoints.token_roi: New DUT branch points since seed per 1000 API input+output tokens; token subsets not double-counted.

failure_policy: Retain failed attempts, checker alarms, unknowns and exclusions. No early stop for target attainment or unresolved verdict. Input/measurement infrastructure failures explicitly marked.
session_independence: Six fresh local UUIDs, stateless Responses requests with store=False, no conversation/previous_response_id. Only current arm/repetition history; no old live actions.
feedback_policy: Reuse original lossless RTL/semantic representation and diagnostics selection: full raw results on disk, totals and first eight per category in prompts equally for B/C; latest 64 actions and 16 trace rows.
review_limitations: Model reviews use static/selective inspection; no claim of complete semantic proof.
K5 excluded; C1-C4 and F1-F8 unproved; timeout/cancellation bounds and sub-row reset remain open.
Repeated HR ERR remains unknown; pin-FIFO read-data rule is a scoped assumption.
